text:
marta (marketing): Quick sync for Fri's product launch livestream — need owners for reg page, Zoom studio flow, local backups, and post-event routing. Can we lock owners here?

ben (events): I can own Zoom + pre-show timeline. Will set alt hosts and waiting room. Need final reg field list and the email templates.

chris (producer): Ill own capture + edits. Plan: local SSD backup + immediate S3 upload script. Need RTMP fallback details and a secure place for stream keys.

evan (growth): Ill own post-event cadence and HubSpot mapping. Reg page should include publish preference and consent.

marta (marketing): Reg page fields proposal: first name, last name, email, company, role, country, timezone, recording_consent (yes/no), publish_pref (public/internal/no). Hidden UTMs and a one-line use-case.

ben (events): Zoom settings: require registration (auto-approve), cloud recording ON, record active speaker + gallery, enable audio transcript, disable file transfer, set chat host-only during live, waiting room T-15. Alt hosts: chris + marta.

chris (producer): File naming scheme: `launch_{YYYYMMDD}_{region}_{stage}.{ext}` e.g. `launch_20260514_na_raw.mp4`. Transcripts `.vtt` and plain `.txt`. I'll also produce 30s social cuts (vertical and landscape).

marta (marketing): HubSpot mapping: campaign=launch-may, source=webinar, map publish_pref -> `webinar_publish_pref`, recording_consent -> `webinar_consent`. Zapier should tag by country and add timezone field.

evan (growth): Post-event emails: Day0: thank-you + calendar + private replay placeholder, Day2: 2-min highlights + CTA (only to publish_pref!=no), Day6: full replay + transcript (public if publish_pref=public). Who drafts Day2?

marta (marketing): Ill draft Day0 and Day6. Evan you take Day2 social + paid copy?

evan (growth): Yep. Also need a 30s paid creative and an HLS snippet. chris can you provide HLS or mp4 clips?

chris (producer): Ill output HLS for internal preview and mp4 cuts for socials. Upload path: `s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-05-14/`. Ill post creds in 1Password.

ben (events): Backup plan: local recording on producer laptop + OBS RTMP fallback to `rtmp://ingest.redwood.prod/live`. chris will have keys in 1Password. I'll also run a T-30 checklist: 1) reg page live + test, 2) Zoom meeting + alt hosts, 3) Producer local backup confirmed, 4) Zapier -> HubSpot test, 5) Pre-show run T-15, 6) Asset handoff.

marta (marketing): Consent policy: if someone selects no-publish, filter them out of any public clips and paid socials. Add `publish_pref` filter in Zapier.

chris (producer): Accessibility: Ill generate `.vtt` captions and a plain-text transcript. Also produce an captions-burned 30s social cut for paid.

evan (growth): One more ask: can we get separate region-specific raw files in case of legal redaction? chris?

chris (producer): Yes — will record separate tracks per region where possible and include timecodes for any customer Q&A segments for redaction.

ops-bot: Reminder: please verify "Allow cloud recording" in account settings and set alternative hosts before the meeting.

marta (marketing): Great — locking owners: Reg & emails=marta, Zoom & ops=ben, Capture & edits=chris, Post-event cadence & paid=evan. Thanks team :rocket:

chris (producer): Ill upload raw within 6h and the 2-min highlight within 24h. Posting S3 path when uploaded.

ben (events): I'll run a test registrant through the Zap now and paste results.
